src: 阁楼新兵训练营 NPC 对话（DialogBaseScript）。游戏显示为 " " + 碎片 + "."，所以键是碎片末尾加句号；XUnity 查找时会去掉开头空格。
带玩家名/按键插入的句子在 00_regex.tsv 的“训练营对话”一节。
Proceed to every Bootcamp post to get training and guide.
zh: 前往训练营的每个岗位，接受训练和指导。

src: *POST: Basic training and weapons.
zh: *岗位：基础训练与武器。

src: *POST: Plastic Shops.
zh: *岗位：塑料商店。

src: *POST: Heavy Weapon.
zh: *岗位：重武器。

src: *POST: Sniper.
zh: *岗位：狙击。

src: *POST: Plastic Medic Tent.
zh: *岗位：塑料医疗帐篷。

src: *POST: Obstacle Course.
zh: *岗位：障碍训练场。

src: *POST: Close Range Weapon.
zh: *岗位：近距离武器。

src: *POST: Builder.
zh: *岗位：建造。

src: *POST: Vehicles.
zh: *岗位：载具。

src: *POST: HQ.
zh: *岗位：总部。

src: Good Luck on your Training.
zh: 祝你训练顺利。

src: We Medic are the most important troop to keep our Army survive from the horror of Plastic War.
zh: 我们医疗兵是最重要的兵种，让军队能在恐怖的塑料战争中活下来。

src: *WARNING: PERMANENT DEATH.
zh: *警告：永久死亡。

src: Go here to shop some Weapon, Grenade, Ability, and more....
zh: 来这里购买武器、手雷、能力等等……

src: Can't go to battle with empty stomach.
zh: 可不能饿着肚子上战场。

src: Don't forget to refill some amunition before going to war.
zh: 上战场前别忘了补充弹药。

src: FAIR PRICE!!!.
zh: 价格公道！！！

src: Have some item to sell? Go here.
zh: 有东西要卖？来这里。

src: Here is some sample item to test it out.
zh: 这里有些样品，拿去试试吧。

src: Don't worry, HQ will able to remold you back if you are dead.
zh: 别担心，你要是阵亡了，总部能把你重新铸造出来。

src: Behind me is a very dangerous Obstacle Course with explosive Land Mines!.
zh: 我身后是一条布满地雷的危险障碍训练场！

src: There is up to 5 scattered Medal in the area. Medal could be useful to recruit more troop to your Main Squad..
zh: 这片区域最多散落着 5 枚勋章。勋章可以用来为你的主力小队招募更多士兵。

src: Good luck!!!.
zh: 祝你好运！！！

src: Let's get to the basic.
zh: 我们从基础开始。

src: There are 3 different Ammunition Box.
zh: 这里有 3 种不同的弹药箱。

src: Primary Ammo will replenish (2x) currently equip weapons on your both hands.
zh: 主弹药会为你双手当前装备的武器补充 2 倍弹药。

src: Spread Ammo replenish (1x) all weapon in your inventory .
zh: 散装弹药会为物品栏里的所有武器补充 1 倍弹药。

src: Grenade Ammo will restock all grenade from your inventory.
zh: 手雷弹药会补满物品栏里的所有手雷。

src: Shooting an enemy increase your XP and will increase your Rank.
zh: 射击敌人能获得经验，并提升你的军衔。

src: Rank will increase your HP and Damage.
zh: 军衔会提升你的生命值和伤害。

src: Try to pick up some weapons and shoot em all up.
zh: 试着捡起一些武器，把它们统统打爆。

src: i hope you didn't forget your plastic license.
zh: 希望你没忘带塑料驾照。

src: Welcome to the Vehicle Section.
zh: 欢迎来到载具区。

src: You could enter any Vehicle you want. Here is the key... take em for a little spin will ya.
zh: 你可以驾驶任何想开的载具。钥匙给你……开出去兜一圈吧。

src: Also you are able to enter any Tower you want, let's test it out on the firing range.
zh: 你也可以进入任何塔楼，去射击场试试吧。

src: use Radio for instant Air Support to specific location.
zh: 使用无线电，可以向指定位置立即呼叫空中支援。

src: Also use Medal Radar to find more Medal in the area.
zh: 还可以用勋章雷达寻找这片区域里更多的勋章。

src: You will need more Medal to recruit more troop to your Main Squad or maybe unlock some other good stuff too for the future battle.
zh: 你需要更多勋章，为主力小队招募更多士兵，或许还能为以后的战斗解锁其他好东西。

src: Go to the Win Medal, if you already done and finish every Boot Camp Post.
zh: 如果你已经完成了训练营的所有岗位，就去拿胜利勋章吧。

src: Heavy weapon are effective against vehicle enemy.
zh: 重武器对付敌方载具很有效。

src: if you could handle the massive recoil... or perhaps....
zh: 前提是你扛得住巨大的后坐力……又或者……

src: Need more firepower? Use dual wield weapon or throw a grenade while holding a Bazooka!!!.
zh: 需要更多火力？双持武器，或者扛着火箭筒的同时扔手雷！！！

src: Pick up some of those heavy weapon, grenade, and dual wield weapon. And start to blast em all to pieces.
zh: 捡起那些重武器、手雷和双持武器，把它们统统炸成碎片。

src: these leaf are useless....
zh: 这些叶子一点用都没有……

src: Wow, i'm suprised you could find me here.
zh: 哇，真没想到你能在这儿找到我。

src: See those targets? Pickup some sniper weapon first and then snipe them from distances.
zh: 看到那些靶子了吗？先捡起狙击武器，然后从远处狙击它们。

src: Carry Flamethrower Fuel for extra degree burn!!!.
zh: 带上火焰喷射器燃料，烧得更旺！！！

src: Pickup up Flamethrower and burn ALL OF EM!!!.
zh: 捡起火焰喷射器，把他们统统烧光！！！

src: *Am i right or am i right? of course im right!!!.
zh: *我说得对不对？当然对啦！！！

src: Who doesn't love the burning plastic in the morning ey?.
zh: 谁不爱清晨燃烧塑料的味道呢，嗯？

src: Welcome to the Builder Post Section.
zh: 欢迎来到建造岗位。

src: Builder are the most imporant Item for Defense and also Offense too!.
zh: 建造包是防守和进攻中最重要的物品！

src: Bigger the Squad, the better! *Will increase Offense and Defense.
zh: 小队越大越好！*能提升攻击和防御。

src: Here i have some little trick for ya!.
zh: 我这儿有个小诀窍教你！

src: Try to spawn two more Army Soldier and then spawn a Jeep. They will quickly form a Squad.
zh: 试着再生成两名塑料兵，然后生成一辆吉普车。他们很快就会组成一支小队。

src: One last thing, you could enter Map Mode to control all Troops coordination.
zh: 最后一件事，你可以进入地图模式，统一指挥所有部队。

src: Build your Special Unit on available Builder icon .
zh: 在可用的建造图标上建造你的特殊单位。

src: Some of our allies still molded into one piece, try to revive them with.
zh: 我们有些战友的塑料身躯还完好无损，试着救活他们。
